title: SCAMMERS
body: This is a SCAM! I never subscribed to this App, and did not enter my credit card! But they managed somehow to charge! Okay, but let’s unsubscribe, I said to myself. But there’s no information about subscription on my AppStore and anywhere else. Moreover, I logged in into the App using credentials sent to me via email, and in the App there’s no way to manage Subscription! The only choice i have so far is to change my card!!! Scammers! I don’t recommend interacting with this App!
